計畫用肉球按開零食櫃。
精準計算角度與力度。
結果只按到了空空的開罐器。
content.scene: A hand-painted book illustration of 阿橘, an orange short-haired tabby with amber eyes and cream paws, standing on his hind legs. He is mid-leap toward a kitchen counter, one paw stretched out with intense focus, only to realize he has accidentally landed face-first into an empty, shiny metal tuna can. Soft afternoon sunlight filters through a window, highlighting his fluffy fur.
